2.4 The RAG System under Investigation:

The ATLAS Model Our investigation examines ATLAS (Izacard et al., 2023) as an example of a RAG model that inte- grates parametric and non-parametric components to utilize external data effectively. This integration, and the fact that ATLAS is pre-trained jointly with a retriever, makes it well suited to studying how information is synthesized in response to a prompt.
